newsitem.title: USA: Econophone introduces $0.12/min US-UK phone rates.
newsitem.headline: Econophone introduces $0.12/min US-UK phone rates.

text.p: Econophone Inc said it had reduced telephone rates to the United Kingdom to $0.12 per minute off-peak and $0.16 peak, effective Monday.
The company said the new rates inaugurating the long distance carrier's Northern Telecom Ltd DMS 100 switch in London.

The company said it is positioning itself to become a leader in the global telecommunications industry following an investment by Morgan Stanley Group Inc, which gave it a minority stake in the long distance carrier.
"The London switch is the first fruit of Morgan Stanley's $14 million investment in our company," Econophone said.

"This, together with our carrier-grade DMS250/300 switch in New York, augments our seven circuits on the PTAT and CANTAT-3 transatlantic fiber optic cable systems, giving us an exceptionally low cost which can be passed on the consumer in the US and UK." ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
